tasks.subject: Task 4: Container smoke matrix (podman)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the OBS-built image behaves per the spec's runtime contract.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create (scratch): $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.sh
- Modify on defects (via Task 3 loop): root/ppg/devel/pgadmin/containers/percona-pgadmin4/obs/*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] T1 login 200 + ver=91700 + idempotent restart
- [ ] T2 password _FILE works, both-set errors
- [ ] T3 servers.json imported (sqlite row in server table)
- [ ] T4 TLS serves https 200, missing certs errors
- [ ] T5 pg_dump 14-18 present + DEFAULT_BINARY_PATHS['pg-16'] = /usr/pgsql-16/bin
- [ ] T6 --user 12345:0 boots to 200
- [ ] log at $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.log; ledger quotes T1-T6 tokens + image tag/digest

**Verify:** bash $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.sh 2>&1 | tee $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.log | grep -E '^T[1-6] (PASS|FAIL)' -> six PASS, zero FAIL

The full smoke script is given verbatim in the plan document (Task 4 step 1). A FAIL is an image/entrypoint defect: fix in the tree via Task 3's push loop, re-run the whole matrix; never edit the smoke script to pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["root/ppg/devel/pgadmin/containers/percona-pgadmin4/obs/Dockerfile", "root/ppg/devel/pgadmin/containers/percona-pgadmin4/obs/entrypoint.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.sh 2>&1 | tee $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.log | grep -E '^T[1-6] (PASS|FAIL)'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["T1 login 200 + ver=91700 + idempotent restart", "T2 password _FILE works, both-set errors", "T3 servers.json imported (sqlite row in server table)", "T4 TLS serves https 200, missing certs errors", "T5 pg_dump 14-18 present + DEFAULT_BINARY_PATHS['pg-16'] = /usr/pgsql-16/bin", "T6 --user 12345:0 boots to 200", "log at $SCRATCH/sp5/smoke-image.log; ledger quotes T1-T6 tokens + image tag/digest"], "modelTier": "standard", "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```
